answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind a single hardware-attested key before it can transact. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities hits the nadir of profitability fast: every fake key demands its own stake, and duplicate signing triggers slashing that burns the deposit. Honest agents climb the knoll gradually, earning reputation through verified work, while the stake acts as a trellis that supports trust without a central gatekeeper - cheap for one real agent, ruinous for an army of sock puppets.
